title: Python: GCLI-120 round 1 non-blocking notes: exactness blind spots, in-repo star trust, direct C.__class__() forms
description: Non-blocking notes from Opus round 1 of opum-ai/glyph-cli#210 (GCLI-120). (1) starSetIsExact still certifies __all__.insert(...), __all__[i:] = ..., a function-level __all__.append, and globals()['len'] = ...; these predate the delta. (2) starOverride (calls.ts ~2710) and resolveStarBound trust an inexact set for in-repo names: def helper then from s import * where s does for helper in [print]. (3) Direct C.__class__() (~3594), m.C.__class__() (~4025) and the module alias import m; f = m.__class__ (~3842-3857) still resolve to an in-repo def __class__. (4) starSetIsExact is not memoised per star target. (5) Note only: the externalBaseBefore flagged edge for class D(dict, A) when a possibly-shadowed dict falls through. Ordinary, not on the hold list; sits beside GCLI-134.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the three exactness blind spots in note 1 refuses the builtin claim, red before and green after
The in-repo star trust in note 2 refuses where the target binds the name through a form the set misses, with a positive twin
The three direct __class__ forms in note 3 resolve no edge to an in-repo def __class__, with a positive twin
starSetIsExact is computed once per star target

implementationNotes: Opus round 2 of #210 (db921f57), non-blocking, not fixed in #210. F1: the classmethod fixture (python-hops.test.ts, 'classmethod under an inexact complete star'; calls.ts isStarPossiblyBuiltin) conforms to DEC-303 (a13) N8, per opum-doc (2026-11-26T21:52Z): a @classmethod under a partial (inexact) star cannot claim the decorator as the builtin, so there is no receiver and no edge. Dev's edge to app.py:C for cls() broke N8 by trusting an inexact star as exact, the defect GCLI-120 fixes. Not a moved or lost edge; the earlier 'same as dev' remark in the round 1 report was unmeasured and wrong. F2: '__all__ += [...]' (handleAugmented, calls.ts ~1780, all.length === 1) and module-level comprehension loop variables (calls.ts ~1228 and ~2165) make ordinary modules count as inexact. F3: N1 is only partly fixed: loop, with and match bodies still count as unconditional (isConditionalStatement ~1792; fix via maySkipStatement ~1840). F4: the bare '__all__: T' fixture pins a lost correct edge (root cause modules.ts 554-556). F5: no killing test for the clauses all.length === 1, kind === assign and viaGlobal !== true in starSetIsExact. F3 was measured (nested __all__ in a for, while or with body, then a for len): a wrong builtin claim that predates GCLI-120; see GCLI-136, on the hold list.

Opus round 2 of #212 (GCLI-122, bbd29313), non-blocking, not fixed there: (1) a shadowed-builtin base on a descendant (import x as Exception) has no fixture (calls.ts ~3772, builtinClassBaseName ~3982-3990). (2) The cross-module fixtures cover only a descendant binding __class__ in its own body; none puts the mixin or external base in the other module. (3) The own-body check in the descendant loop (calls.ts ~3764) is now redundant with the MRO loop that follows. (4) descendantsOf uses baseAlternatives while computeMro uses resolveBaseClass, so a conditional or rebound base yields an opaque rebound entry and refuses; that matches DEC-303 (a68) and (a12)(b).
